issues.message: The aligned MU/MUU history is under two full trading years, so regime coverage is limited.

limitations: MUU history begins in October 2024, leaving only three complete 63-session out-of-sample folds.
Daily bars cannot evaluate intraday T-trading, spread dynamics, partial fills, or same-day stop execution.
The study is descriptive and out-of-sample tested, but does not establish future profitability.

methodology.selection_metric: training annualized Sharpe after commission and slippage
methodology.signal_timing: close signal, next regular-session open fill
